fix.x: The tropical (solar) year – equinox to equinox – is 365 d 5 h 48 min 46 s; the extra ~quarter day is why leap years are added. 365 d 6 h 9 min 9.5 s is the sidereal year (one orbit measured against the fixed stars).

why: Tropical year = 365 d 5 h 48 m 46 s (~365.2422 d); 365 d 6 h 9 m 9.5 s (~365.2564 d) is the sidereal year, so the marked option was wrong.
